entities.name: Formimidoyltransferase-cyclodeaminase
observations: 541 aa protein; exact sequence hash match to reviewed Gallus gallus FTCD Q9YH58.
Contains FTCD_N, FTCD, and FTCD_C domains spanning the formiminotransferase and cyclodeaminase modules.
Bifunctional folate-dependent enzyme in histidine degradation and tetrahydrofolate interconversion.
Curated EC assignments: EC 2.1.2.5 and EC 4.3.1.4.
Curated active-site positions: residue 82 for formimidoyltransferase and residue 412 for cyclodeaminase.
Reference oligomer is a homo-octamer arranged as a tetramer of dimers.

entities.name: FTCD transferase reaction
observations: Mapped to Rhea RHEA:15097 and EC 2.1.2.5.
This is the glutamate formimidoyltransferase half-reaction.

entities.name: FTCD cyclodeaminase reaction
observations: Mapped to Rhea RHEA:22736 and EC 4.3.1.4.
This is the formimidoyltetrahydrofolate cyclodeaminase half-reaction.

entities.name: Histidine degradation
observations: FTCD channels the formimino group from N-formiminoglutamate (FIGLU) into the folate pool while producing glutamate.
The enzyme links L-histidine catabolism to one-carbon/folate metabolism.
